summary: Core DB, HLC, protocol, sync server/client, space codes compile and pass 59 tests. UniFFI bindings (AC13), cdylib target (AC14), and SqliteStorageBackend (AC12) are missing.

criteria.reason: Schema creates todos, projects, areas, tags, headings, sync_kv with correct columns. PRAGMAs set in open_db.
All 16 CRUD operations implemented in db.rs and dispatched from main.rs. INSERT OR REPLACE semantics, bool as INTEGER, JSON TEXT for tag_ids/checklist_items/recurrence_rule.
main.rs reads JSON per line from stdin, dispatches to handler, writes JSON response. Wire format matches existing sidecar.
HLC with tick, merge, compare, to_string, from_string. Format <ISO8601>:<counter:06d>:<device_id>. Splits on Z. Tests pass.
VersionVector = HashMap<String,String>. compute_vector_diff and compute_local_excess implemented and tested.
split_into_batches respects MAX_BATCH_SIZE=100 and MAX_BATCH_BYTES=1MB. Tests for count and byte limits pass.
All 9 message types as enum with serde tag discriminator. snake_case fields. SyncEntity.type via rename, deleted skip_serializing_if. Serialization tests pass.
WS server on port 21531 with tokio+tungstenite. Hello validation, version_vector exchange, peer_list, sync_changes batches, live_change forwarding, ping frames.
WS client with address racing (tokio::spawn per address, oneshot for first winner). Exponential backoff 2s base/30s max. Stopped flag. Full protocol flow.
PeerRecord struct with all fields. merge_peer_records unions addresses, keeps newest last_seen. Persisted via sync_kv sync.peers key.
generate_space_code 12-char Crockford. encode/decode_ipv4 7-char. Extended 19-char. format/parse for 7/12/19. derive_space_id SHA-256 first 16 hex. QR payload ark://join URI. All tested.
StorageBackend trait is defined but no SqliteStorageBackend implementation exists anywhere in the crate.
No uniffi dependency in Cargo.toml. No UniFFI annotations or UDL file. No exported surface for Kotlin/Swift.
Cargo.toml has crate-type = ["lib"] instead of ["cdylib", "lib"]. No cdylib output for UniFFI.
Protocol messages use snake_case, SyncEntity.type serializes as type, deleted omitted when None. Deserialization of TS-compatible JSON tested.
59 unit tests pass covering HLC, version vectors, batch splitting, space codes, peer records, protocol messages, DB CRUD.
